root_layout: a run of {u32 pointer, u32 count} pairs, POINTER FIRST, with a few lone pointers. Pointer positions come from the DSIF relocation table, so the pair boundaries are stated by the game's toolchain rather than inferred.
part_table: the pair whose 8-byte records carry their own index in byte 1. That is the table packet+0x29 indexes when a hit lands on a part.
